title: Design System: PhoneDock site
scope: Public landing page in site/ only. The Mac app design guide is design/DESIGN.md.

themes.mechanism: CSS light-dark() on :root with color-scheme light dark. data-theme="light" or "dark" on <html> forces a theme, stored in localStorage as pd-theme.

display.purpose: Hero headline only. Below 820px it is clamp(2.125rem, 9.4vw, 2.75rem). The closing heading uses 800 weight at 116% width, clamp(2.5rem, 5.2vw, 4.75rem), -0.035em.

lede.purpose: The opening statement of What it is, capped at 44ch.

title.purpose: Setup step titles, device names, Privacy and limits subheads (680 to 700, 1.0625 to 1.25rem).

sub.purpose: Lines under section headings, in ink-2, max 38rem.

label.purpose: Uppercase condensed column labels in the How it works diagram.

code-block.purpose: Flow YAML and terminal output in the prompt book.

shadows.name: hub-lift
shadows.purpose: PhoneDock card in the How it works diagram.

shadows.name: icon-drop
shadows.purpose: App icon in the closing section, as a filter.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every CSS transition and keyframe on the page.

motion.name: key-state
motion.purpose: Key border and background. Press is 0.12s with a 1px drop.

motion.name: lamp
motion.purpose: Lamp dot lighting on hover or focus.

motion.name: nav
motion.purpose: Nav wash and rule after 24px of scroll.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Section blocks fade up once on entry, only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: stage-fade
motion.purpose: The WebGL canvas fades in over the poster.

motion.name: handoff-ring
motion.purpose: Pulsing ring on the cue light in the handoff state. Static at 0.6 opacity with reduced motion.

motion.name: wire-packet
motion.purpose: Packets along the diagram wires while visible. Off with reduced motion.

motion.name: pool
motion.purpose: Closing light pool brightens from 0.25 to 1 opacity when in view.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Cue panel placed above the 3D window. Nav links shown.

breakpoints.name: mid
breakpoints.purpose: Hero stacks: stage, cue panel, copy. Gutter 40px, section padding 96px. Nav links hide.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column grids, gutter 20px, section padding 72px, prompt book pages stack.

breakpoints.name: small
breakpoints.purpose: Keys share the row width, GitHub label hides.

fallbacks.poster: Rendered stills of the same Three.js scene at the handoff moment, per theme and for narrow screens (site/assets/hero-poster-*.webp), each with a provenance JSON.
fallbacks.cue: Static cue panel that holds the handoff moment with working Take Over and Done and a polite live region.

narrative.northStar: The Stage Seen from the Booth
narrative.overview:
The page is a stage manager's view of a show. Phones stand on their marks under a light rig, an agent calls the show, and a cue light hands the one step it can't do to a person. Dark mode is show mode: matte black tinted indigo, cool light pools, a faint haze beam over each phone. Light mode is work-light mode: the app's pale stage grey with white paper and graphite ink. Both themes come from one set of `light-dark()` custom properties on `:root`, and the 3D stage reads its own colours from the `LOOKS` table in `site/js/stage.js`.

Saturated colour belongs to state. The three control colours from the Mac app (agent purple, you indigo, needs-you orange) mark who is in control, and the accent indigo fills the primary key. Everything else is ground, paper, ink and hairline rules. Sections are long ruled lists and two-column grids on the bare ground, with very few boxed containers. The real product carries the proof: the 3D hero, a screen recording of the handoff, captured phone screens in CSS handsets and a phone recording in the Prompts run-sheet.

Motion is gentle and always optional. The hero stage, the wire packets in How it works, the handoff ring and the reveals all stop under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Recordings play only while on screen and always carry a Pause/Play control.
keyCharacteristics: Two themes from one token set, switched by `light-dark()` and a stored toggle.
Archivo variable, expanded and heavy for headlines. JetBrains Mono only for tool calls, commands and YAML.
Buttons are cue-light keys with a lamp dot.
State colour appears only as round cue lights, lamp dots and state-coloured text or fills.
Hairline-ruled lists (run-sheet, setup steps, handoff steps, FAQ) carry most sections.
A Three.js stage in the hero, with a rendered poster for reduced motion and no WebGL.

rules.name: The State Colour Rule
rules.body: Purple, indigo and orange mean agent, you and needs-you everywhere on the page and in the 3D scene. Don't use them for decoration.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Control colours match `design/DESIGN.md` exactly, per theme. New state colours start in the app's guide, then come here.

rules.name: The Wide Headline Rule
rules.body: Headlines use Archivo at 110% to 116% width with negative tracking (-0.028em to -0.035em). Body text stays at 100% width.

rules.name: The Typed Text Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only for tool calls (`get_ui`, `tap`, `request_human`), shell commands and flow YAML or terminal output. Prose, labels and buttons never use it.

rules.name: The Inner Padding Rule
rules.body: A bordered or filled container keeps at least 8px of inner padding between its edge and its content.

rules.name: The Lit Is Live Rule
rules.body: Light marks what is active: the phone in play gets the spotlight, the lit handoff step follows the recording, and the closing pool brightens when it scrolls into view.

dos: Do take every colour from the custom properties on `:root` and give each new token a light and dark value through `light-dark()`.
Do keep agent purple, you indigo and needs-you orange tied to agent, person and help-needed states, matching `design/DESIGN.md`.
Do make buttons as keys: a lamp dot, 10px corners, 48px height, hairline border, and the indigo fill only for the primary action.
Do set headlines in Archivo at 110% to 116% width, 760 to 800 weight, with negative tracking.
Do keep JetBrains Mono for tool calls, commands, YAML and terminal output.
Do keep at least 8px of inner padding in any bordered or filled container.
Do give every moving element a reduced-motion path and every video a visible Pause/Play control.
Do show the real product (renders of the app, screen recordings, captured screens) and mark each shipping raster's origin in its sidecar JSON.
donts: Don't use the state colours as decoration, gradients or section tints.
Don't set prose, labels or buttons in JetBrains Mono.
Don't add hard offset shadows. Lifted objects use the long, soft, negatively spread shadows listed above with a hairline edge.
Don't use front-of-house theatre imagery (curtains, masks, velvet, marquee bulbs).
Don't put a small uppercase label above a section heading. Condensed caps are kept for diagram column labels and the Beta tag.
